default.about: living/configs/models.json as it stands. Since 694821c/b8cfdba people think with glm-flash (zai-glm-5-3-flash) at reasoning effort low for think and high for deliberate, talk, consolidate and internalize, max_tokens 24000, prompt caching on, overflow deepseek-flash; animals think, remember and compile with glm-flash. Level of detail and lessons off.

deepseek-flash.about: People think with deepseek-flash (deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017; overflow glm-flash); otherwise as default.

projects.about: Default with LIVING_PROJECTS=1: each person keeps a few self-chosen projects (self -PURSUES {progress, next_step}-> project:<slug>) that consolidation and the nightly reorganization add, revise and end, and every deliberation sees (at most 3) and may say it serves; the thought row records which.

lod.about: Default with LIVING_LOD=1 (no player on stage).

glm-flash-low.about: People think with glm-flash sent with reasoning_effort low for every purpose. Replaying one real compile request (2026-11-09): as sent, 43.8 s with 5,742 reasoning tokens of 6,149 completion; with low, 3.4 s, 0 reasoning and 211 completion tokens; "none" is refused (HTTP 400). Before 694821c the profile sent no effort; since 694821c/b8cfdba main sets per-purpose efforts, and this variant overrides them all to low.

deliberate-low.about: As default, with glm-flash's deliberate (compile) effort lowered from high to low; think stays low, talk/consolidate/internalize stay high. A patch to living/configs/models.json, merged as given.

instinct.about: No mind: the subject lives on its graph alone (instinct-only control, e.g. for wolf packs).

people.about: People think with the `people` mix of living/configs/models.json as their default (think glm-flash; deliberate deepseek-flash@low on stage, glm-flash off stage; talk deepseek-flash; consolidate and reorganize glm-flash).

recall600.about: Default with LIVING_RECALL_TOKENS=decide=600 (main's default is decide=800).

animal-switches.about: Default with LIVING_ANIMAL_MINDS=salient,choose: think on salient change, one-call choice from a menu (docs/MIND_HARNESS.md item 3). Until 2026-11-12 also `pack` (one animal's decision copied to the others it saw), retired as shared hidden state (docs/PACK_MIND.md).

greet-control.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_GREET=off, LIVING_PARK=wait: the shipped conversation rules (the control). Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

greet-nearest.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_GREET=nearest: a remark to no one from someone the hearer has not met or barely knows draws one turn, from the nearest hearer within 6 m free to talk. Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

greet-curious.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_GREET=curious: such a remark may draw in a hearer within 6 m by curiosity (remark draw x (0.5 + 0.5 curiosity/100)); the first drawn takes the one turn. Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

greet-facing.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_GREET=facing: the hearer the speaker faces (within 6 m and 0.6 rad of the facing) is addressed, whoever spoke. Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

park-concurrent.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_PARK=concurrent alone: a line addressed to a listener whose deliberation is running gets its turn alongside it when it came within 2 s after the prompt was built, or once the deliberation has decided and its words are not for the speaker. Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

greet-nearest-concurrent.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_GREET=nearest with LIVING_PARK=concurrent. Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

greet-facing-concurrent.about: People think as `default` (living/configs/models.json as it stands). Conversation switches (living/mind/src/mind/talk.rs; docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Conversations): LIVING_GREET=facing with LIVING_PARK=concurrent. Under every LIVING_GREET mode but off, an addressed line from such a speaker skips the remark draw, and hostility (affinity <= -40) no longer counts as caring. LIVING_GREET needs the world's `speech_audience` law (the greet trial sets it).

player-frame.about: Default with LIVING_FRAME=player: people's deliberation (think and compile), consolidation and conversation-turn system prompts open with a short frame saying the model is an AI playing this person in a persistent world shared with other players, human and AI, where the person's body, needs, death and the world's rules are real and what to pursue is its own choice, and whatever the person says or writes stays in their own words (prompts.rs PLAYER_FRAME). Everything else as default. Probes: prompt_frame (requests that carried the frame) and ooc_lines/ooc_private (living/tools/ooc.py).

arrive-control.about: Default (the shipped rules and mind switches as they stand): the arrival trial's control world. The newcomer-law arms (arrive-notice, -known, -wonder, -all) were rejected on 2026-11-12 as prescribed attention and removed (docs/TRIALS.md, "Arrival batch ar2").

strangers-control.about: The strangers trial's control: main's defaults, the `stranger_by_name` law off (a graph's "stranger" is someone with no relation row).

strangers-filter.about: The strangers trial's filter arm: `stranger_by_name` on (set_world_law after the laws guard): a graph's "stranger" is someone whose name one does not know (docs/STRANGERS.md, section 3).

strangers-filter-cues.about: Stage 2b's fourth arm, LS + cues: `stranger_by_name` on and the attention-cue law `cues_on` on (docs/ATTENTION.md; set by set_world_law).

strangers-first-sight.about: Strangers C + first sight (docs/FIRST_SIGHT.md): the `first_sight_thinks` law on (set_world_law after the laws guard), its gap as shipped (300 s): a first sight of someone one cannot place asks one thought. Everything else as `strangers-control`.

strangers-filter-cues-fs.about: LS + cues + first sight (docs/FIRST_SIGHT.md): `stranger_by_name`, `cues_on` and `first_sight_thinks` on (set_world_law after the laws guard).

strangers-first-sight-hf.about: C + first sight, with the crowd fixes (docs/FIRST_SIGHT.md, "Crowds"): `first_sight_thinks` and `heard_first_rethinks` on (set_world_law after the laws guard). Whom someone walks to is named in every arm since first-sight-crowd (no switch).

strangers-earshot.about: Strangers control + earshot (docs/COMMUNICATION.md §17): the `earshot` law on (set_world_law after the laws guard): a person's scene says whom a line said now would reach, at each way, among the people they see ("who would hear you now"). Everything else as `strangers-control`.

gate-off-ds.about: The live gate check's control (docs/GATE_LIVE.md): the strangers C arm (`strangers-control`: main's laws) with the `people` mix as trials run it, except that think goes to deepseek-flash (deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017, effort low for think) instead of glm-flash. The rethink gate is off (no LIVING_RETHINK).

gate-jev-ds.about: The live gate check's gated arm (docs/GATE_LIVE.md): as `gate-off-ds`, with the rethink gate on (LIVING_RETHINK=jev; living/configs/rethink.json as shipped: Jev jev-1.14.0, proceed_above 0.3, max_hold_s 600). Nothing else differs.

pack-minds.about: Pack arena with minds on both sides (docs/PACK_MIND.md): people on the models file's default, wolves routed by its species map, LIVING_ANIMAL_MINDS=salient,choose (no pack: retired). fast_lane_on stays off (the world law's default).
